steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough... cough, cough...!
A violent cough rips through you, and your lungs sear with the effort.
The dark fog ahead has been blasted apart, but beyond it, fresh waves of the same sickly haze bleed through the sky's thin cracks, gathering their strength.
Chengxiao holds the line between you and them, his outline traced in eerie green flame. He raises his blade and points the way.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Follow this path straight ahead. It will take you to the rendezvous point. I suggest you don't linger.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can we... even keep going...? I don't think we'll last much longer like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those things were after me. If we run into more of them...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You needn't worry about that. They know that your <color=#fb9259>price</color> has already been paid by another.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: His <color=#fb9259>price</color>... has it not already been paid by another?
steps.female_content: Her <color=#fb9259>price</color>... has it not already been paid by another?

steps.content: Another <color=#fb9259>price</color>. Paid by "another" on your behalf.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about you?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...I left something with Li Xianling. I won't be leaving just yet.

A thread of urgency runs through his words, enough to make you study him more closely. Faint streaks of dark corruption stain Chengxiao's arm, marks eerily similar to the ones that had eaten into Lichen before.
You turn toward her body, meaning to check your suspicion, but a jarring splash of color stops you cold.
Her hand has turned a vivid, blood-red, and blurred golden runes drift across its surface like living talismans.
[Red screen flash + severed limb & blood splatter sound effects]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: You want a <color=#fb9259>price</color>...?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Fine. Come and take it!
[24 Transition Flashback End]
So the person Chengxiao talked about is...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait! ...I left something down there too.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: What did you leave? I can retrieve it for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But how are you planning to get down there? Lichen destroyed the coin. If you force your way in like she did, you'll be affected too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can go in and help you find it. I just need to fall asleep to enter the Void of Yin. I don't need a coin.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I have other tools. And the fact that even the coins could barely hold out down there is precisely why I cannot allow you to go charging into the Void of Yin in a <color=#fb9259>child's</color> body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I have a way to find Lichen, and it'll be fast.
Chengxiao's brow lifts at your words. He looks ready to cut in, but instead presses his lips shut and waits for you to finish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She only just entered the Void of Yin, and Maria City is already like this. If we leave her down there, things here are only going to get worse.
All around you, the ghostly green cracks in the sky keep widening. The phantoms' faint shrieks leak through from the realm beyond.
You shift your eyes meaningfully toward his arm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That thing you lost is affecting your body too, isn't it? That's why you can't leave. With the cracks spreading, the anomalous activity spiking, phantoms crawling out of every crack... can you really hold out here?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And it's just Keylan and me on the road. No telling what might happen along the way. What if neither of us makes it?
Chengxiao looks down and sighs quietly.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: If it will truly set your minds at ease, then stay by my side for the time being.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I will try not to take long. Retrieve what is mine, assess the situation, and then I'll stop. We leave together after that.
He raises his palm, and threads of talisman light leap from his fingers, weaving a protective circle at your feet that pushes back the roiling darkness encircling you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since we're staying, let me try to find Lichen.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She... promised me.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You still wish to go after her.
Your mouth opens, ready to push back, but no words form. There's honestly nothing to deny. Still, the certainty in his voice lands like an accusation, and you feel the heat of unjustified guilt.
After a pause, Chengxiao breathes out a small laugh and looks down, murmuring to himself.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: She really does have a way with people. Even after everything she's done...
He turns to face you again, the last trace of amusement gone from his expression. His voice, when he speaks, is entirely serious.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Are you not afraid of her?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Manipulating faith. Commanding phantoms. Nearly getting you killed just now. All of that was her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But wasn't it also Lichen who paid that price for me just now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The person you mentioned is her, isn't it?
You look over at Lichen's body. But Chengxiao doesn't follow your gesture.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's not the first time she's done something like that... I had a part in what she has become too.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: If you believe this is your burden to carry, there is no need.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: A price, simply put, is nothing more than bearing the consequences of one's own choices.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Whether it was choosing to come to Maria City, attempting to bend the hearts of the living to cross the boundary between life and death, or paying that price on your behalf... every one of those was a decision she made herself.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: That being the case, these are the fruits of her own making. Hers alone to bear.
He pauses, and his tone eases, growing almost gentle. Still, what he says next lands heavy, dragging something inside you lower.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: All of it has nothing to do with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're not wrong about that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But back then, it was my choice to enter the Void of Yin in her place. And my choice to help her cross the boundary between Maria City and the Void of Yin. Those were decisions I made myself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said it yourself. You make a choice, you pay the price. If I do nothing now, isn't that just me running away from it? Even those phantoms couldn't sort out how the price should be paid in all of this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's exactly why I can't just leave her behind.
Chengxiao's expression stays mostly neutral, hard to read. Then, unexpectedly, a smile breaks through.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The two of you really are rather alike...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Go on, then. Try your luck down there.
So... that leaves one practical problem. How are you supposed to fall asleep?
You clamp your eyes shut, but after everything you've just been through, your brain is racing, offering not a shred of drowsiness.

Chengxiao regards you with a knowing look, as if he'd expected this all along. His fingers move swiftly through a sequence of seals, and with each motion, your eyelids droop further. Maria City melts away before you, bleeding steadily into the Void of Yin.
